verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party docs page titled 'Server-Side Data Scrubbing' (sentry-docs-29), which shows Sentry documents its own server-side scrubbing capability, but the pack gives no detail on how the rules work. Nothing in the evidence covers SDK-level filtering or shows that scrubbing happens before sensitive payloads persist. missing for 10: SDK-level PII filtering (e.g., client-side event hooks or default PII controls), details of server-side scrubbing rule configuration, evidence that scrubbing occurs before storage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
